# cloudsmith_organization (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the organization in URIs.

### Read-Only

- `country` (String) Country in which the organization is based.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which the organization was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `location` (String) The city/town/area in which the organization is based.
- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the organization.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm immutably identifies the organization. It will never change once an organization has been created.
- `tagline` (String) A short public description for the organization.
